faq.q: Where and what is OmShakthy Elite Orchard?
faq.a: OmShakthy Elite Orchard is a prestigious residential plot development located in Guduvanchery. Being one of the renowned plot developers in Chennai we have crafted this plot of land with ingenious layout. Elite Orchard spans across 25 acres, housing 510 plots ranging from 640 sq.ft to 3282 sq.ft, designed for those who dream of building their own home in a posh and vibrant community with ample lifestyle amenities.
